FIELDS.NAME: Shutter & Lens Photography Studio
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Shutter & Lens Photography Studio, we specialize in providing high-quality photography services focused on portrait, event, commercial, and product photography. Our operations are primarily centered around a dedicated studio space designed to create an optimal environment for clients to capture their special moments. We utilize standard studio equipment to ensure consistency and reliability in our shoots, and our team includes skilled photographers and assistants who are dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences. We prioritize client satisfaction and adhere strictly to all local business, zoning, and health and safety regulations to maintain compliance and minimize operational risks. Additionally, we offer ancillary services, such as makeup and hairstyling, which support our photography services without being the primary focus of our business. Shutter & Lens maintains comprehensive insurance coverage and actively manages our inventory within the limit to ensure financial soundness and operational stability.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in activities that exceed $500,000 in total inventory value and confirms that the use of drones for photography or videography is strictly prohibited. Additionally, we do not conduct any chemical processing or utilize darkroom chemicals, nor do we offer pet grooming or animal care services, ensuring full compliance with operational standards.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Photography by the Shore LLC, a local photography agency specializing in coastal event photography.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, water damage occurred due to a leaky roof during heavy rain, resulting in loss of $1,200. The issue has been resolved, and the roof was repaired. On July 10, 2023, a client reported a damaged backdrop during a rented session, leading to a loss of $800. The matter has been settled with the client. Total losses amount to $2,000.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1 Safe - UL Listed, Fire Resistant, rated for $50,000 in cash and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24/7 on-site security personnel.
